subject: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints

Team —

We have our Exec QBR prep window next week. I want to run a tight two-day prep cycle so the deck is ready for leadership review by EOD Friday. Primary asks:

- Account-by-account one-pagers for the top 12 deals (2 slides each max). Focus: current ARR, committed timeline, blockers, and risk level (green/amber/red).
- Cleaned forecast numbers consolidated at the account and rep level (best / likely / commit). Include underlying assumptions for any >20% movement.
- OKR checkpoint: call out any models/infra asks that would materially affect Q2 delivery (latency targets, Dedicated capacity requests, or major security gating).

Please prioritize Acme Corp (ACME-2027-EXPAND-39) — they asked for a QBR readout and procurement is looping in legal. Marissa, can you own the Acme one-pager and confirm the procurement timeline with Alice? Rishi, can you produce a consolidated forecast sheet by EOD Wednesday (include confidence band and a recommended commit figure)? Hannah, please start a slide deck skeleton and reserve the Deck master for me to sign off. Olga — please pull token-level latency/cost delta for the top 5 production customers and flag anything that looks like an OKR risk.

Attachments: none here — I will assemble the final deck.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan Blake
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints

Jordan —

I'll take Acme. Quick summary (attached: ACME_account_brief_v3.pdf):

- Current ARR: $520k (annualized run-rate from P0 + 3 pilot projects)
- Near-term committed: $420k expected to land in Q2 (legal/procurement gating, internal PO needed)
- Timeline: Procurement conversation this week (Alice is pulled in). Target signature: 05/06/2027.
- Blockers: SSO + data residency clause in the SOW; legal has a few redlines on data retention.
- Risk: AMBER — strong commercial alignment but legal timelines uncertain.

Notes: I attached the one-pager and the procurement tracker. Alice — can you confirm the internal PO cadence on your side? If we can get a firm PO by 05/03 we should expect the revenue to slip into Q2.

Thanks,
Marissa

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: ACME_account_brief_v3.pdf, acme_procurement_tracker.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints

Jordan / team —

Attached is the consolidated forecast workbook (forecast-consolidation-2027Q2.xlsx). High level:

- Pipeline snapshot (top 12 deals): Commit = $2.1M, Likely = $3.4M, Best = $4.8M.
- Confidence: aggregate commit confidence 68% (we've been conservative on 3 accounts where legal is still negotiating).
- Recommended commit adjustment: +$100k on Acme once PO is confirmed; otherwise maintain current commit.
- Notes on movement: two mid-funnel accounts (BetaCloud and Helix) show increased probability after product POC completion. BetaCloud has procurement dates: 05/11/2027 per Tom.

Quick excerpt (pasted):
- ACME: commit $420k (confidence 55% pending PO/legal)
- BETACLOUD: commit $300k (confidence 75% per POC)
- HELIX: commit $180k (confidence 60%)

I flagged accounts where we should consider early-booking forecasts vs. conservative commit. Use the workbook column "Suggested Exec Commit" — I pulled a recommended figure based on rep ask + historical closure variance.

Attachments: forecast-consolidation-2027Q2.xlsx (sheet: consolidated, sheet: assumptions)

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints

Jordan —

Started a slim deck skeleton and added a placeholder for the Acme summary slide. I added slide owners:

- Cover / agenda: Jordan
- Exec summary + top asks: Jordan / Olga
- Forecast consolidation slide: Rishi
- Account spotlights (Acme, BetaCloud, Helix): Marissa
- OKR / infra risks: Olga

I uploaded the skeleton to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qBrfQBR-assembly-2027 (see qbr-deck-slides-jordan.pptx).

Marissa — can you drop a one-slide procurement status for Acme (key redlines + requested SOW language) into the deck by EOD today? Rishi — make sure the consolidated commit is on slide 3 with the confidence band.

Thanks —
Hannah

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Program Manager, GTM Operations

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR: Executive Sprint — account briefs & OKR checkpoints

Thanks for the fast turn. Quick consolidation & next steps: 

- Marissa: Acme one-pager looked great — I pulled the PDF into the deck and put your slide in slot 6. Please follow up with Alice for a PO update; if they can confirm by Monday morning (05/03), we'll treat $420k as committed.

- Rishi: I reviewed the forecast workbook. I want the commit line to reflect recommended exec commit (don't overwrite rep commit column). We will present both commit and suggested-commit in the deck. Please freeze the workbook and upload final to Drive by 9am Friday.

- Olga: please add a one-slide OKR risk summary with token-cost deltas for Acme + BetaCloud. Call out any latency regressions that could impact SLA promises.

- Hannah: finalize the deck skeleton, I'll do a pass Friday afternoon and send to exec.

Internal follow-up meeting: I scheduled a 30-min dry-run for Friday 10:00–10:30 PT (invitation sent). If anyone needs more time, ping me and we'll extend the run-through.

Attachments included in the thread: qbr-deck-slides-jordan.pptx, ACME_account_brief_v3.pdf, forecast-consolidation-2027Q2.xlsx

Jordan
